points.description: States that the queue is implemented as a circular array, i.e. the array is treated as circular so that indices wrap around from the last position back to the first. Equivalent wording (e.g. 'index wraps around using modulo the array size') earns the mark.

Places the front of the queue toward the beginning of the array and the rear toward the end, with the rear pointer wrapping around to the start of the array when it reaches the end. Equivalent wording earns the mark.
points.partial_credit: Award 1.5 if the student correctly places the front at the beginning and the rear at the end of the array but does not mention the rear wrapping around to the start.

rubric.notes: Full marks (5) for stating a circular array in which the front sits at the beginning, the rear sits at the end, and the rear wraps around to the start. Partial credit (1.5 or 2) for placing front and rear at opposite ends of the array without the wrap-around, or for mentioning a circular array without the front/rear placement. No marks for a plain linear array description with no wrap-around or for answers that do not address the array structure.
